Ideally situated just minutes from the Old Quarter, the hotel offers a welcome haven from the bustling city center. InterContinental® Hanoi Westlake is an iconic hotel in the heart of the vibrant district of Tay Ho, offering travelers luxurious guest rooms and bespoke Club InterContinental service. Experience multi-award-winning dining at Saigon restaurant or capture a magnificent sunset at Hanoi's only overwater bar, Sunset Bar. The hotel is minutes away from the city's most alluring attractions, while at the same time offering a peaceful escape in a beautiful and iconic lakeside setting.
